_note: Horror prompt presets for Kimodo (its demo's Preset dropdown; tools/kimodo_presets.py measures them). Prompt style: 'A person ...', one behaviour, medium detail (docs/ANIMATION.md). 'expect' is what the check measures on each take; 'checked' is the last result; 'tip' says what the words can't do.

presets.prompt: A stealthy person sneaks forward slowly, looking around.
presets.tip: Kimodo won't crouch from text: for a low stalk, arm the library's crouch pose (Pose window) on the Full-Body track.

presets.prompt: An injured person limps forward, dragging their right leg.
A person crawls forward on their hands and knees.
A frightened person crouches into a ball on the floor, hands over their head.
A scared person slowly walks backward.
presets.tip: It backs off at walking pace whatever the words: draw a Path at Sneak pace to slow it.

presets.prompt: A scared person stands still and looks around nervously.
An angry person lunges forward and grabs with both hands.
A drunk person staggers forward and almost falls.
A person falls down onto the floor and lies still.
A person gets up from lying on the floor and stands up.
A tired person shuffles forward slowly with their head hanging down.
A scared person jumps back in fright.
